triggers.fact: Appointed Sumita Pandit as Chief Financial Officer, effective September 9, 2026.
Careers page notes a workforce of over 140,000 employees across more than 30 countries.
Appointed Ajith Madhavan as Vice President to strengthen Finance and Operations leadership in June 2026.
Appointed Dinesh Jain as Global Capability Center (GCC) Lead on November 11, 2025.

pain_hypothesis: Managing employee commute transport across a large global workforce of over 140,000 employees introduces operational complexity and high fleet costs that require automated scheduling, routing, and billing.
